appraisal_events.evidence: elle répondit avec colère, heureuse... de me montrer que j'étais dans le faux et elle dans le vrai: « Mais jamais ma tante n'a connu personne à Infreville... » Elle avait oublié le mensonge qu'elle m'avait fait un soir sur la dame susceptible... Je ne lui rappelai pas son mensonge. Mais il m'accabla.
appraisal_events.explanation: Albertine confidently and angrily denies any connection to Infreville, believing she has proven herself right, but the narrator's silent memory of an earlier, now-forgotten lie of hers quietly undercuts her credibility even though he says nothing aloud.

status_effects.explanation: Albertine's confident denial is undercut by the narrator's private recollection of an earlier lie, quietly discrediting her credibility even as she believes she has won the argument.
The unspoken memory of Albertine's earlier lie crushes the narrator anew, deepening his private emotional burden even as he stays silent.
